messages.subject: Re: Alloy surcharge and base price for 1.4404 bar
messages.body:
Dear Edelstahl-Service Donautal GmbH team,

You cite market increases, yet your earlier letter says your alloy requirements are covered at fixed prices—it seems the key issue is which increases have actually reached your costs. We value the partnership and want a longer commitment grounded in a transparent price basis. How would you substantiate the requested increase through the cost-breakdown XLSX you offered to discuss, separating fixed-price material costs from processing costs and accounting for increases already reflected in our purchase prices?

We confirm a binding volume of 94,800 units per year for 24 months. Our orders for Round bar 1.4404 dia 30 mm, peeled rose from EUR 5.17 to EUR 5.45 within 9 months (po:4500013278-10, po:4500013392-10, po:4500013795-10, po:4500014455-10). Producer prices DE: cold drawing of bars changed -2.3% from 2026-06 to 2026-08 (idx:PPI-C2431@2026-06, idx:PPI-C2431@2026-08). Our demand forecast for Round bar 1.4404 dia 30 mm is up +1.9% (fc:370010@2026-09). Could you share your cost breakdown for this part, so we can understand the drivers together?

On this basis we propose the attached term sheets (EUR 4.72 per unit, no index clause, 30 days payment, 24 months). Please let us know which option works best for you.

Kind regards,
Purchasing, Hollerau Pumpenwerke

messages.subject: Re: Alloy surcharge and base price for 1.4404 bar
messages.body:
Dear customer,

We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows. We checked the index change data you cited; it holds and we took it into account. We checked the price history data you cited; it holds and we took it into account. We checked the volume change data you cited; it holds and we took it into account. 

AS-14404 rose 5.9 % in twelve months and is 45 % of our cost. That remains. LCI-C rose 2.7 % in twelve months and is 5 % of our cost. That remains. PPI-C2431 rose 12.3 % in twelve months and is 38 % of our cost. That remains. Material accounts for about 45 % of our cost; more detail we do not share. Our price follows our main cost drivers: AS-14404, PPI-C2431, LCI-C.

We welcome your commitment to a 24-month term for 94,800 units per year, which enables us to lower our offer to €5.31 per unit. To support this extended 24-month period, we must include the AS-14404 index clause, as our alloy requirements are only covered at fixed prices for a limited time. 

Our current Angebot stands at a price of €5.20 per unit, Zahlungsziel 30 days net, a contract term of 24 months, a Preisgleitklausel on AS-14404. 

As an alternative, at a price of €5.31 per unit, Zahlungsziel 30 days net, a contract term of 24 months, a Preisgleitklausel on AS-14404. Alternatively, with a Preisgleitklausel on AS-14404: €5.31 per unit.

This offer is valid for 30 days. We are happy to discuss this in a call; until then our offer stands.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Georg Aigner
Inside Sales, Edelstahl-Service Donautal GmbH

messages.subject: Re: Alloy surcharge and base price for 1.4404 bar
messages.body:
Dear Edelstahl-Service Donautal GmbH team,

You tie the need for an alloy clause to the limited duration of your fixed-price coverage—it sounds like your concern is exposure after that protection expires. We want a defensible price basis that distinguishes secured costs from future risk. How can we separate that future exposure from the base price while your alloy costs remain fixed?

We confirm a binding volume of 94,800 units per year for 24 months. Labour cost index DE, manufacturing, seasonally and calendar adjusted (quarterly, carried to its three months) changed -0.3% from 2025-10 to 2026-01 (idx:LCI-C@2025-10, idx:LCI-C@2026-01).

On this basis we propose the attached term sheets (EUR 4.82 per unit, no index clause, 30 days payment, 24 months). Please let us know which option works best for you.

Kind regards,
Purchasing, Hollerau Pumpenwerke
